title: The Last Ember
author: Jude Pemberton
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
